question: 'Padhe Bharat’ reading campaign, launched by the Department of School Education and Literacy to support and encourage children to read for a joyful learning experience started on January 1, 2022, for a period of ________ days.
solution:
The correct answer is __**100**____.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Education and Skill Development Minister Dharmendra Pradhan launched a 100-day Reading Campaign ‘Padhe Bharat’ on Jan 01, 2022. 
 
• Children studying in Balvatika to grade VIII will be part of this campaign.
 
• The reading campaign aims to have the participation of all stakeholders at the national and state levels including children, teachers, parents, community, educational administrators, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Objectives of the Padhe Bharat Campaign **

 
• The campaign strives to support and motivate students, along with all stakeholders at the state and national levels, including schools, teachers, parents, and communities, to foster a joyful learning experience through reading.
 
• It has designed one activity per week per group,** emphasizing making reading an enjoyable activity and building a lifelong association with the joy of reading**.
 
• Children studying from **Balvatika to Grade 8** are the primary focus of the campaign.
 
• It also emphasizes Indian languages, including mother tongue/local/regional languages.
 
• The campaign celebrates International **Mother Tongue Day on 21st February** with the activity of **"Kahani Padho Apni Bhasa Main"** (Reading story in own language), promoting local languages and culture.
 
• The reading campaign will run from **1st January 2022 till 10th April 2022, spanning 100 days (14 weeks)**.
 
• The campaign aligns with the vision and goals of the foundational Literacy and Numeracy mission (NIPUN Bharat).
